fact: UNICEF Equatorial Guinea says the SIREC digital birth registration system, running since late 2018, lets all Malabo residents register births fully digitally, with extension to the continental region aimed for 2019 and national coverage later.
The World Bank's WDI lists completeness of birth registration in Equatorial Guinea at 53.5% for the 2011 survey round, a national rate not tied to a digital system; as_of is the round's year.
